evidence.ranking: One best saved mode per indicator/timeframe; highest positive net return across timeframes; raw wins exact mode ties.
limitations: Post-outcome rankings are not clean prospective evidence; no new model fits or validation were performed.
Independent unlevered long/short asset accounts, not a combined funded portfolio; no funding, borrow, liquidation or intrabar-extreme risk.
Drawdown is measured on native 15-minute closes; higher-frequency/intrabar risk can be larger.
Three chronological model/policy versions generated the full-history result; fold3 alone did not earn earlier returns.
No minimum trade count; some highly ranked strategies have very few trades.
Training/calibration/selection include 23 assets. ENA removal applies only to the separately saved MFI1h pooled sensitivity, not these individual rankings.
ALL policies do not filter entries by score; NONE policies admit no entries. Raw setup ties are represented as raw.
Original native model bytes and ordered features are retained. Separate live inference needs explicit fold3 selection and fresh closed candles; the frozen evidence is unchanged.
